Messages.Author: TorranceCircle
Messages.Body:
Looking at Malloy's post.

If I put Nosferatu Bestial into play with an anarch, Is the Bestial an anarch?If not, is it Camarilla?Independent?

Nosferatu Bestial

Action

Requires Nosferatu
cost = 1 pool
+1 stealth action. Unique.
Put this card into play. This card represents a unique Nosferatu with 2 capacity and basic Animalism . The Bestial cannot act except to hunt, cannot cast votes or ballots and cannot have equipment. During your untap phase, this Bestial may employ a retainer from your hand that requires Animalism (requirements and cost apply as normal). This is not an action and cannot be blocked.

I'm also wondering if it combos with Revolutionary council.

Messages.Author: jhattara
Messages.Body:
Nothing on the card about the sect so it defaults to the standard Nosferatu sect, which is Camarilla.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
The Nosferatu Bestial is a Nosferatu Vampire. His default sect is the default sect of Nosferatu, which is Camarilla (whoever the sire is).
He can be turned into an anarch (Anarch Convert, Galaric's Legacy, ...) in which case he could then be used for Revolutionary Council purpouses.

Messages.Author: Robert Scythe
Messages.Body:
> The Nosferatu Bestial is a Nosferatu Vampire. His default sect is the default sect of Nosferatu, which is Camarilla (whoever the sire is).
>
This comes from the inane and counter-intuitive standing ruling. Which is why when Angus The Unruled uses his Justicar ability to Third Tradition he spits out independent brats. It should just be the sect of the sire that determines the sect of the childer, but whatever. This, however, would not grant anarchdom to your Bestial even so, just independence. It would still have to embrace Anarchism to benefit the Council.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Well, I can't really make a ruling for Angus...

Anyways - it's all about what the card reads. Some creations inherit sect (Bambas, for instance), some don't. Those who don't simply get the default.
